in_marathi.name: Anayansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God in the heart
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anayansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anaya (god within) + Ansh (presence). This name signifies the presence of God within the heart. It is derived from the ancient Sanskrit language and is considered a powerful and spiritual name in Hindu culture.
